name: Jingdeng Wangye
source:
She is a polite, modest, and knowledgeable Illuminator and is able to answer many uncommon questions. Although she is the most frequently relied-upon Arboranger in Earthcaress Beacon, almost no one has seen her fighting. Generally, she is only responsible for strategizing and planning.

[spoiler]Long ago, in order to save the dying Lanteria, Tranquillia transferred her soul into a newborn Illuminator: committing this sin was a "necessary evil" for her.[/spoiler]
translation:
She is a polite, modest, and knowledgeable Illuminator and is able to answer many uncommon questions. Although she is the most frequently relied-upon Arboranger in Earthcaress Beacon, almost no one has seen her fighting. Generally, she is only responsible for strategizing and planning.

[spoiler]Long ago, in order to save the dying Lanteria, Tranquillia transferred her soul into a newborn Illuminator: committing this sin was a "necessary evil" for her.[/spoiler]
